basics.name: Martin Birkenbaum
basics.label: Senior Software Engineer
basics.summary: Senior Software Engineer with 8+ years of experience designing, building, and deploying high-performance, scalable distributed systems and microservices. Expertise in cloud-agnostic infrastructure orchestration, GitOps, and optimizing system efficiency for large-scale operations.

work.name: Initech Corporation
work.summary: Led architecture and development of high-performance, distributed microservices and GitOps-driven infrastructure pipelines, focusing on maximizing compute efficiency.
highlights: Designed and implemented high-throughput, Python-based event-driven microservices, processing 10M+ daily events in a distributed system.
Standardized containerized deployments utilizing Docker and Kubernetes, leveraging GitOps workflows for production-grade model releases.
Mentored 6 junior/mid-level engineers, fostering technical excellence and establishing robust code quality and testing standards.
Developed custom internal toolchains, optimizing CI pipeline execution times by 40% and enhancing overall compute efficiency.

work.name: Hooli Inc.
work.summary: Backend engineer focused on building scalable RESTful APIs, high-performance developer tooling, and robust automated deployment integrations for distributed systems.
highlights: Developed robust, scalable REST APIs in Python/Django and TypeScript/Node.js for distributed applications.
Integrated third-party APIs and automated webhook processors, enhancing system resilience and external data traffic management.
Implemented a comprehensive suite of unit and integration tests, increasing code coverage from 60% to 92% and ensuring system reliability.
